placement: One AMD Milan guest, CPU 1 in a single-CPU cgroup, SMT disabled. All three frozen anchors are paid once on this guest before the comparisons.
schedule: In each round visit queries in plan order rotated left by round. Alternate fresh and session first by (round + original query index) parity. Each arm prepares once, then actually enforces each deadline in listed order. Share a single new private session across all queries and rounds; only round zero populates a query. Distinct Fenwick stdin bytes on the same ELF and bank must both miss initially.
comparison: Each arm receives the same ordered one-anchor bank. Replay admission, anchor receipt, terminal/crossing counters, actual status, exit and PID for each run. A fallback or discrepancy is reported and is ineligible for a same-clock timing claim. This study evaluates repeat preparation and decision agreement; inputs and broad deadlines were selected from previous studies and are not new native accuracy evidence.
cost: Record monotonic elapsed and cumulative RUSAGE_SELF and RUSAGE_CHILDREN user and system readings immediately before and after each preflight and each fresh live enforcement. Report paired totals by cold/warm state; charge frozen anchor construction separately. Include live checks in end-to-end sums, counting every enforcement. No previously cached wall time or target CPU is charged on warm preflight.
